Listopia > 100 Best Books of All Time: The World Library List
List of 100 best books of all time, as voted on by 100 writers in 54 different countries. List reflects works from multiple countries, cultures and time periods. Compiled in 2002 by Norwegian Book Clubs. Per http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bokklubb... .
